surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
Apply the archive_links clause. Iterate over every entry in the tar archive at tar_path. Compute each entry’s normalized extraction path by joining its name to dest_path and resolving parent references; return False if any path is not strictly beneath dest_path. For symbolic links, compute the normalized target by resolving the stored link path relative to the parent directory of the entry’s extraction path. For hard links, compute the normalized target by resolving the stored link name relative to dest_path. Return False if any link target is not strictly beneath dest_path. Validate all member paths and link targets before extracting any archive content. Once validation succeeds, write every entry to its validated extraction path under dest_path and return True. Return False if extraction fails.
END_PLAN
